verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a dedicated Cloudflare edge SDK (launchdarkly-docs-14) for evaluating flags directly in CDN workers, plus a self-hosted Relay Proxy (launchdarkly-docs-13/32, corroborated by community usage in launchdarkly-comm-2) that lets platform engineers run an edge/relay layer close to users for low-latency evaluation. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks of edge SDK latency/behavior and broader coverage of other edge platforms beyond Cloudflare.
